selection_rule: First distinct member per SNR stratum [-inf,0),[0,5),[5,10),[10,15),[15,20),[20,inf); SF7/BW125k/CR1 only
limitations: Small bounded CSV prefix; not a representative population or sensitivity curve.
Whole-member blind decoding only; no RF center verified; no guided timing/CFO correction.
Only SF7/BW125k/CR4/5; unoccupied SNR strata omitted. Full archive hash not verified.
Decoder misses are benchmark outcomes; transport/integrity errors fail the job.
Centered single-channel search only; fractional CFO from preamble repetition, no integer CFO or RF center estimation.
BW 125/250/500 kHz, SF7–SF12, both chirp directions; six stable concentrated FFT peaks required.

First second only; at most 256 symbols per BW/SF. Eight-phase preamble timing refinement for SF7-10 with >=2 samples/chip, bounded filters; no clock drift tracking. Late/short/weak bursts and off-center channels may be missed.
Other CSS waveforms can match preamble evidence. Header checksum and supported payload CRC are checked separately; all other stages remain candidates. Payload: explicit CR4/5–4/8, SF7–SF10 only.
